lines: Do you know that foot smell can help to save many Africans every year?
In Africa, a large number of people every year are killed by malaria.
This disease is carried by mosquitoes.
A study found that smelly feet can draw malaria-carrying mosquitoes.
That’s because malaria-carrying mosquitoes like smelly feet more than mosquitoes that don’t have malaria.
Because of this study, people are making a special kind of trap that smells like feet.
Once mosquitoes enter the trap, they cannot get out of it.
Some say this trap can’t completely solve the malaria problem and we need to do more studies to learn how to fight malaria.
But the development of this trap is still a meaningful discovery for reducing malaria.
